key_provisions_or_claims: Vision of Israeli high-tech as an AI-first industry across four axes: applications, infrastructure, technological breakthroughs, geopolitics.
Target of an Israeli company among the top 3 in Physical AI and a Physical AI applied research institute.
Regulatory sandboxes, dual-reality ventures (like the national drone initiative) and serial test sites for AI and robotics.
Dedicated certification tracks for the safety of autonomous systems and stronger presence in international standards bodies.
Deepening alliances such as Pax Silica and bilateral R&D to secure compute and chip access.
annotation.summary_en: Draft AI strategy by the Israel Innovation Authority, released for industry comment in April 2026. It sets a vision for Israeli high-tech to lead globally in AI through four axes (applications, infrastructure, breakthroughs such as Physical AI, and geopolitical alliances), and proposes sandboxes, test sites, certification for autonomous systems and funding.

annotation.title_en: Strengthening the Global Leadership of Israeli High-Tech in the AI Era: Where Excellence Outweighs Size – Vision, Goals and Operational Steps
